summary: ansible-builder build -t <name> tags the image (default name ansible-execution-env) and -f selects another definition file; ansible-builder build --help lists other options.
questions: How do I name the image built by ansible-builder?
What is the default ansible-builder image name?

answer_card.title: Tag an ansible-builder image
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-builder build -t my_first_ee_image
ansible-builder build -f another-definition-file.yml -t another_ee_image
```
Without `-t`, the image is named `ansible-execution-env`. See `ansible-builder build --help` for more flags.
